title: incident-bot: enrich on-call diagnostics with escalation context and runbook hints
description:
Motivation: Oncall responders frequently need quick escalation context (who to page, SRE runbooks, recent related incidents) surfaced directly in the incident-bot diagnostics. This PR adds an escalation context enrichment pipeline that aggregates team on-call rosters, runbook quick-links, and recent incident summaries, and surfaces prioritized hints in the on-call diagnostics message.

Summary of changes: added a new escalation_context service that queries the oncall-roster API and runbook-index, synthesizes a short priority list, and attaches it to diagnostics payloads. The incident-bot handler now requests escalation context when generating oncall diagnostics (configurable via new flag enableEscalationContext). UI changes: compact quick-links added to the runbook attachment payload. Telemetry: new metrics incident_bot.escalation_context.fetch_latency_ms and incident_bot.escalation_context.fallback_count.

Testing & rollout: feature guarded behind a runtime flag and disabled by default. Unit/integration tests included for the synthesizer and fallback behaviour. Rollout plan: enable for internal SRE first, monitor metrics for fetch latency and fallback_count for 48 hours, then enable for production namespaces.

Related tickets: Linear ENG-2312 (escalation-context MVP), SRE-98 (oncall runbook surfacing).

Checklist:
- [x] New service + tests
- [x] Feature flag + config defaults
- [x] Add telemetry and dashboards
- [x] Documentation and runbook link examples

Notes: We fall back to prioritized runbook matches when roster lookup fails. The synthesizer keeps the hint text < 480 chars to remain readable in Slack/Teams attachments.

Liam O'Sullivan: Please add a short note in the deployment docs about enabling the flag and the expected additional external call. Also suggested a circuit-breaker on repeated roster failures.
Noah Patel: Added deployment note and simple failure counter used by the synthesizer as a soft circuit-breaker. Will follow up with a more sophisticated breaker in a follow-up PR.
release_notes: Adds escalation context enrichment to incident-bot diagnostics: surfaces on-call roster entries, prioritized runbook quick-links, and recent related incident summaries. Guarded by feature flag.
